mike_collections: Heads-up: Onyx Systems INV-2026-1203 ($11,200) hit final dunning. ACH return code R29. No active card on file.
sara_billing: flag noted. customer is a channel partner — Ethan, any context?
ethan_sales: they said they'd apply a retainer credit from a recent professional services contract to cover this, emailed proof of credit memo but hasn't uploaded signed offset agreement. CFO asked us to hold collections while they process retainer.
maya_support: confirmed support ticket 13022 requesting hold to avoid service disruption. customer wants a one-week grace while finance reconciles.
lena_legal: legal will allow a temporary 7-day hold if we get a signed offset authorization that explicitly ties the credit memo to INV-2026-1203 and waives refund for that credit. I'll provide a short template.
mike_collections: policy: can pause dunning for 7 days for partner-retainer cases with signed offset + confirmed ledger entry. require AR note and escrow tag.
collections_bot: Action: set INV-2026-1203 status to "hold_for_offset". Dunning paused until 2026-05-04.
sara_billing: requested uploaded credit memo and signed offset agreement by EOD 2026-04-27. also requested a single manual ACH retry if they can't apply retainer.
ethan_sales: CFO replied: "we will upload signed offset by EOD and confirm retainer application." attached preliminary credit memo (pdf).
mike_collections: ok — create AR watch and ledger placeholder: CSV snapshot:
account,invoice,amount,status
Onyx Systems,INV-2026-1203,11200,hold_for_offset
sara_billing: scheduling follow-up reminder 2026-05-04 to confirm resolution. if no docs by then, proceed with collections.
collections_bot: Reminder set: check_INV-2026-1203 on 2026-05-04.
mike_collections: closing this thread pending docs. reopening if ACH retry or collections action needed. closing ts 2012341020
